class.name: PlayFabPartyChat
class.description:
Reached as [code]PlayFab.party.chat[/code] (or [method PlayFabParty.get_chat]). Chat is decoupled from the transport peer: it is fully meshed by the Party SDK — every connected chat control sees every other — and is addressed by PlayFab entity keys (a [code]{ "id", "type" }[/code] dictionary) rather than transport peer ids. There is exactly one local chat control per local user. Chat-control creation is decoupled from network join: create it explicitly with [method create_local_chat_control_async] (which owns the audio devices and the voice/text/transcription flags from the [PlayFabPartyConfig]), then [method PlayFabParty.create_and_join_network_async] / [method PlayFabParty.join_network_async] connect that control to each network automatically. Network join never creates a chat control. The control survives leaving and rejoining and is only destroyed via [method destroy_local_chat_control_async], user release, or Party shutdown. [codeblock] # Create the local chat control once (before joining a network): var result = await PlayFab.party.chat.create_local_chat_control_async(user, config)
# Send to the whole mesh (empty target == broadcast): PlayFab.party.chat.send_text_async("hello everyone")
# React to incoming messages: PlayFab.party.chat.text_message_received.connect(func(entity_key, message): print(entity_key.id, ": ", message.text))
# Chat indicators are polled, never signalled: func _process(_delta: float) -> void: var speaking := PlayFab.party.chat.get_local_chat_indicator() == PlayFabParty.LOCAL_CHAT_INDICATOR_TALKING $MicIcon.visible = speaking for entry in PlayFab.party.chat.get_chat_indicators(): _update_roster_row(entry.entity_key, entry.indicator)
# Push-to-talk mutes the local microphone: PlayFab.party.chat.set_audio_input_muted_async(not Input.is_action_pressed("talk")) [/codeblock]

method.name: create_local_chat_control_async
method.description: Explicitly creates the local chat control for [param user], decoupled from any network join. The audio input/output devices and the voice/text/transcription flags from [param config] are applied to the control here, where it is owned. A local user keeps a single chat control reused across networks; subsequent network joins for [param user] connect this control automatically. Idempotent — a second call for an existing control resolves with that control. The completed [PlayFabResult] carries the [PlayFabPartyChatControl] on success.

method.name: destroy_local_chat_control_async
method.description: Explicitly destroys the local chat control for [param user]. Idempotent — a no-op success when [param user] has no chat control.

method.name: get_local_chat_control
method.description: Returns the local [PlayFabPartyChatControl] bound to [param user], if any.

method.name: get_chat_controls
method.description: Returns all known [PlayFabPartyChatControl] instances, local and remote.

method.name: get_remote_entity_keys
method.description: Returns the PlayFab entity-key dictionaries ([code]{ "id", "type" }[/code]) of every remote chat control currently in the mesh.

method.name: get_chat_control
method.description: Returns the [PlayFabPartyChatControl] identified by the PlayFab entity key [param entity_key] (a [code]{ "id", "type" }[/code] dictionary), if known.

method.name: send_text_async
method.description: Sends [param message] through the local Party chat control. [param target_entity_keys] is an array of PlayFab entity-key dictionaries ([code]{ "id", "type" }[/code]); an empty array broadcasts to every remote chat control in the mesh; unknown entity keys return a failed [PlayFabResult].

method.name: set_audio_muted_async
method.description: Mutes or unmutes incoming [b]voice audio[/b] from the chat control identified by the PlayFab entity key [param entity_key] on the local chat control. Independent of [method set_text_muted_async]. Emits [signal audio_muted_changed] on success.

method.name: set_chat_permissions_async
method.description: Updates the local chat-control relationship permissions for the chat control identified by the PlayFab entity key [param entity_key]. See [enum PlayFabParty.ChatPermission].

method.name: set_text_muted_async
method.description: Mutes or unmutes incoming [b]text chat[/b] from the chat control identified by the PlayFab entity key [param entity_key] on the local chat control. Independent of [method set_audio_muted_async]. Emits [signal text_muted_changed] on success.

method.name: get_local_chat_indicator
method.description:
Returns whether the local player is currently talking, silent, muted, or has no working microphone. See [enum PlayFabParty.LocalChatIndicator].
PlayFab Party raises no state change when an indicator flips, so this must be polled — typically once per frame or on a UI refresh timer. When [param user] is [code]null[/code] the first local chat control is used.

method.name: get_chat_indicator
method.description:
Returns the voice activity of the chat control identified by the PlayFab entity key [param entity_key], as observed by the local chat control. See [enum PlayFabParty.ChatIndicator]. Polled, not signalled.
Passing the local player's own entity key reports [constant PlayFabParty.CHAT_INDICATOR_TALKING] while the local capture pipeline is active and [constant PlayFabParty.CHAT_INDICATOR_SILENT] otherwise, so a single roster loop can drive every row.

method.name: get_chat_indicators
method.description: Returns one dictionary per remote chat control, each shaped [code]{ "entity_key": { "id", "type" }, "indicator": int }[/code], where [code]indicator[/code] is a [enum PlayFabParty.ChatIndicator] value. Convenience for driving a whole voice roster from a single poll.

method.name: is_audio_input_muted
method.description: Returns whether the local microphone is muted.

method.name: set_audio_input_muted_async
method.description: Mutes or unmutes the local microphone. This is the local player's own mute — use it for push-to-talk and mute toggles. [method set_audio_muted_async] mutes [i]other[/i] players instead.

method.name: get_audio_render_volume
method.description: Returns the playback volume, in the range [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code], applied to the chat control identified by [param entity_key].

method.name: set_audio_render_volume_async
method.description: Sets the per-player playback volume for the chat control identified by [param entity_key]. [param volume] is clamped to the range [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code].

method.name: get_chat_permissions
method.description: Returns the currently applied chat permissions toward [param entity_key]. See [enum PlayFabParty.ChatPermission].

method.name: is_audio_muted
method.description: Returns whether incoming voice audio from [param entity_key] is muted locally.

method.name: is_text_muted
method.description: Returns whether incoming text chat from [param entity_key] is muted locally.

method.name: get_language
method.description: Returns the BCP-47 language code of the local chat control.

method.name: set_language_async
method.description: Sets the BCP-47 language of the local chat control. This is the language used for outgoing text chat and voice transcription, and the target language for receiver-side translation. Usually set once via [member PlayFabPartyConfig.language]; use this to change it at runtime.

method.name: get_transcription_options
method.description: Returns the active voice transcription bitmask. See [enum PlayFabParty.TranscriptionOptions].

method.name: set_transcription_options_async
method.description: Sets which chat controls get transcribed. See [enum PlayFabParty.TranscriptionOptions]. Transcription is off unless at least one flag is set; [member PlayFabPartyConfig.enable_transcription] applies a sensible default at chat-control creation.

method.name: get_text_chat_options
method.description: Returns the active incoming text-chat bitmask. See [enum PlayFabParty.TextChatOptions].

method.name: set_text_chat_options_async
method.description: Sets receiver-side options applied to incoming text chat, such as translating into the local language or filtering offensive text. See [enum PlayFabParty.TextChatOptions].

method.name: get_audio_encoder_bitrate
method.description: Returns the outgoing voice encoder bitrate in bits per second.

method.name: set_audio_encoder_bitrate_async
method.description: Sets the outgoing voice encoder bitrate in bits per second. Lower values reduce bandwidth at the cost of voice quality.

method.name: get_voice_audio_options
method.description: Returns the active voice audio processing bitmask. See [enum PlayFabParty.VoiceAudioOptions].

method.name: set_voice_audio_options_async
method.description: Sets voice audio processing options such as noise suppression. See [enum PlayFabParty.VoiceAudioOptions].

method.name: get_audio_input_state
method.description: Returns the last reported microphone state. See [enum PlayFabParty.AudioInputState]. Poll this to show a "no microphone" or "microphone access denied" affordance instead of silently having no voice.

method.name: get_audio_output_state
method.description: Returns the last reported playback device state. See [enum PlayFabParty.AudioOutputState].

method.name: populate_text_to_speech_profiles_async
method.description: Asks PlayFab Party for the synthetic voices available to the local chat control. On success the list is readable with [method get_text_to_speech_profiles].

method.name: get_text_to_speech_profiles
method.description: Returns the [PlayFabPartyTextToSpeechProfile] snapshots cached by the last successful [method populate_text_to_speech_profiles_async]. Empty until that call completes.

method.name: get_text_to_speech_profile
method.description: Returns the [PlayFabPartyTextToSpeechProfile] currently selected for [param type]. See [enum PlayFabParty.SynthesizeTextToSpeechType]. Returns [code]null[/code] when no profile is selected.

method.name: set_text_to_speech_profile_async
method.description: Selects the synthetic voice used for [param type]. [param profile_id] is a [member PlayFabPartyTextToSpeechProfile.identifier] from [method get_text_to_speech_profiles]. See [enum PlayFabParty.SynthesizeTextToSpeechType].

method.name: synthesize_text_to_speech_async
method.description: Synthesizes [param text] using the profile selected for [param type]. [constant PlayFabParty.TEXT_TO_SPEECH_TYPE_VOICE_CHAT] transmits the audio to the chat mesh as if the local player had spoken it, which is the accessibility path for players who cannot use a microphone. [constant PlayFabParty.TEXT_TO_SPEECH_TYPE_NARRATION] renders locally only.

signal.name: state_changed
signal.description: Aggregate signal for chat-control state changes.

signal.name: chat_control_added
signal.description: Emitted when a chat control identified by the PlayFab entity key [param entity_key] (a [code]{ "id", "type" }[/code] dictionary) joins the mesh.

signal.name: chat_control_removed
signal.description: Emitted when the chat control identified by the PlayFab entity key [param entity_key] leaves the mesh.

signal.name: text_message_received
signal.description: Emitted when a text chat message is received from the chat control identified by the PlayFab entity key [param entity_key].

signal.name: transcription_received
signal.description: Emitted when a speech-to-text transcription is received from the chat control identified by the PlayFab entity key [param entity_key].

signal.name: chat_permissions_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the local chat-control relationship permissions for the chat control identified by the PlayFab entity key [param entity_key] change.

signal.name: audio_muted_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the incoming [b]voice audio[/b] mute state of the chat control identified by the PlayFab entity key [param entity_key] on the local chat control changes.

signal.name: text_muted_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the incoming [b]text chat[/b] mute state of the chat control identified by the PlayFab entity key [param entity_key] on the local chat control changes.
